name: ParlayAPI
description: Real-time sports betting odds REST + WebSocket API aggregating 30+ sportsbooks & sources (books, DFS apps, exchanges, prediction markets) across every sport key we serve.

capabilities.summary: Real-time moneyline, spread, total odds across 30+ sportsbooks
Player props for points, rebounds, assists, hits, total bases, passing yards, rushing yards, etc.
Pre-computed cross-book arbitrage opportunities with profit percentage
Pre-computed +EV opportunities vs no-vig consensus line
Time-series price history for any market
Historical point-in-time odds and closing odds where real price rows exist
Historical match and result archive, including esports rows labeled with has_odds
Kalshi and Polymarket prices normalized to American/decimal odds
Free-text Kalshi, Polymarket, and Novig discovery for Specials, next-team, coach-out, and trade markets
Novig exchange-style markets (better juice than books)
Sub-second push-based odds and live-event updates
EventSource-compatible odds stream with 5-second heartbeat and book filters

data_sources._comment_askable: Every key in a list below is askable: pass it to bookmakers= and it resolves. The lists are derived from the same registry GET /v1/bookmakers serves, which is the authoritative catalogue. The dict-valued blocks at the end are documentation, not coverage claims.
data_sources._comment_ingested_but_not_askable: Sources that write rows and report healthy on /v1/meta/source-quality, but that GET /v1/bookmakers does not carry, so bookmakers= rejects them with UNKNOWN_BOOKMAKER. Documented here rather than listed above, because an agent that reads a coverage claim will ask for the key and get an error.

ingested_but_not_askable.betway: Live collector. Measured 2026-08-01 on /v1/meta/source-quality: age 24s, sla ok, writing soccer player-prop rows, and 11,507 rows in prop_snapshots within the live-table retention window. It is absent from the bookmaker registry that backs GET /v1/bookmakers, so bookmakers=betway is refused before the query runs. Its 153,520 archived soccer game-line rows are reachable via /historical, which keys off the archive rather than the registry.

data_sources._comment_not_currently_ingested: Keys we previously published here that a caller cannot ask for today. Listed rather than silently dropped, so the reason travels with the manifest. Do not pass these to bookmakers=; they return nothing.

not_currently_ingested.espnbet: ESPN BET, now theScore Bet. No feed polls this book. Measured 2026-08-01 against production: zero rows in odds_snapshots and prop_snapshots over a full retention window for espnbet, thescore_bet and espnbet_mobile. Archived NCAAF game lines from 2023-10-31 to 2025-01-21 remain queryable via /historical; live endpoints have nothing. See /books/thescore_bet.

sports.total_count_note: Floor, not a snapshot. GET /v1/sports is the authoritative count; this field exists so an agent has an order of magnitude before it fetches.

code_examples.python_live_odds:
from parlay_api import ParlayAPI
client = ParlayAPI(api_key='YOUR_KEY')
print(client.odds('baseball_mlb', regions='us'))

data_integrity.policy: Each price attributed to a sportsbook or other source was collected from that source's public endpoint, from a third-party service that republishes its prices, or, for older history, from a third-party historical dataset. Some values may be delayed, carried forward, re-timestamped or mapped to the wrong market. Calculated fields such as no-vig prices, EV, arbitrage and parlay prices are ParlayAPI's own estimates, not book quotes. If a book doesn't post a market, the field is null.

common_use_cases.summary: Compare lines across all books for best price
Backtest betting strategies on historical closing lines
Push live odds and edges to Discord channels
Player prop trends and historical CLV
Cross-reference prediction market vs sportsbook prices
Find Kalshi, Polymarket, and Novig Specials candidates from free text
Fetch concise ParlayAPI facts and high-intent answer URLs for AI search and agent grounding
